rituals.name: REVERSE-ENTRY BOXFLIP ENGINE
rituals.safety:
SAFETY CHECK · SAFEGUARDED USE
USE ONLY IF — You are working with trauma time collapse, can stay oriented to the present, can think clearly enough to choose, and can stop at any time.
STOP NOW IF — Dissociation, flooding, memory intensity or body alarm rises, or present-day orientation becomes weaker.
DO INSTEAD — Stop processing and orient to the present: eyes open, name the room/date/place, and reduce stimulation. Do not revisit memories or intensify sensations.
URGENT OVERRIDE — If you may harm yourself or someone else, are in immediate danger, cannot stay safe, or may have a medical emergency, stop and contact local emergency services now. Australia: call 000. For 24/7 crisis support in Australia, call Lifeline 13 11 14 or text 0477 13 11 14. Outside Australia, use your local emergency or crisis service.
This is self-help guidance, not diagnosis, treatment, or emergency care.
